verses.text: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had rebuilt the wall and that there were no gaps left in it, though I had not yet put the doors in the gates.
So Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: "Come, let's meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono." But they were planning to harm me.
I sent messengers to tell them, "I am doing a great work, and I cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to come down to you?"
They sent me the same message four times, and each time I gave them the same answer.
The fifth time, Sanballat sent his helper to me with the same message, and he had an open letter in his hand.

It said, "It is being said among the nations, and Geshem says it is true, that you and the Jews are planning to rebel. That is why you are rebuilding the wall. The reports say you are going to be their king.
You have even chosen prophets to announce about you in Jerusalem, 'There is a king in Judah!' Now this report will get back to the king. So come, let's talk this over together."
I sent him this answer: "Nothing like what you are saying is happening. You are making it up in your own mind."
They were all trying to frighten us. They thought, "Their hands will get too weak to do the work, and it will never be finished." But I prayed, "Now, God, make my hands strong."

One day I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at home. He said, "Let's meet in God's house, inside the temple, and close the temple doors. Men are coming to kill you. They are coming tonight to kill you."
But I said, "Should a man like me run away? Should someone like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go!"
I realized that God had not sent him. He had spoken this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him.
They had paid him to frighten me into doing this and sinning. Then they could give me a bad name and shame me.
Remember, my God, what Tobiah and Sanballat have done. Remember also the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who tried to frighten me.
So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month of Elul. It took fifty-two days.
When all our enemies heard about it, all the nations around us were afraid and lost their confidence. They knew that this work had been done with the help of our God.
In those days the important men of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah's letters were coming to them.
Many people in Judah had promised to be loyal to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah. Also, his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
They kept telling me about the good things Tobiah was doing, and then they reported to him what I said. And Tobiah kept sending letters to frighten me.
